messages.content: With the Thursday return settled, I need to finish Indianapolis lodging for Monday through Thursday. Compare staying at the host hotel, the nearby business hotel, and the cheaper property farther east. The host rate is gone Wednesday, so include a split stay if that is the only way to use it.

I’ll price the three-night arrangements on the same basis: room including taxes, transportation from Monday arrival through Thursday airport transfer, Wednesday-night availability, and cancellation exposure. I’ll also account for Monday’s preparation meeting at the host hotel and site travel Tuesday and Wednesday. Do you need any particular room features checked while I compare them?

Yes. Check whether the room has both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge. Those should weigh in the comparison, but don’t discard an otherwise strong option automatically if one is missing.

Understood. I’ll treat both as favorable room features and flag any gap for a decision rather than eliminating the property. I have three workable structures: two nights at the host hotel plus Wednesday at an airport hotel, all three nights at the business hotel, or all three at Eastgate Suites.
Start with the split. I want to know exactly how disruptive Wednesday would be.

The host hotel has the audit rate Monday and Tuesday at $219 per night including tax, or $438 total. It has no room at that rate Wednesday and no standard room available to bridge the gap. The Airport Courtyard has a Wednesday king available for $168 including tax. Combined lodging is $606. Both room types list a single-cup coffee maker and mini-fridge.
What happens with bags and transportation? There is no team car or shared ride arranged.

Monday’s airport ride to the host hotel is estimated at $42. The host provides its scheduled site shuttle Tuesday and Wednesday at no charge; it will hold your bag after Wednesday checkout and have it ready when the shuttle returns from the site. A rideshare from the host hotel to the Airport Courtyard is estimated at $34. The Courtyard’s Thursday airport shuttle is complimentary. Estimated local transportation is therefore $76, making the split total $682.
Confirm the Wednesday room and the shuttle timing. I cannot have the room disappear while we compare.

The Airport Courtyard currently shows Wednesday, July 8 availability at $168 all-in. Its airport shuttle begins at 4:30 a.m. and runs every 30 minutes; the 5:30 a.m. departure reaches the terminal in about 10 minutes, leaving a comfortable margin for the Thursday flight. The host’s Wednesday site shuttle returns at approximately 4:45 p.m., so you could retrieve your bag and reach the Courtyard around 5:30 p.m.
And the cancellation terms for both pieces?

The host reservation can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Friday, July 3; after that, the penalty is one night including tax, $219. The Airport Courtyard can be canceled until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, July 7; a later cancellation costs the first night, $168. Neither requires prepayment.
Now price the business hotel for all three nights, including every ride we would reasonably expect.

The Meridian Business Hotel has all three nights at $198 per night including tax, for $594. Monday airport transportation is estimated at $38. Its meeting-room shuttle to the host hotel is $18 each way, adding $36 Monday. Its site shuttle costs $16 each way Tuesday and Wednesday, adding $64. A Thursday airport ride is estimated at $39. Transportation totals $177, so the complete stay is $771.
Does Meridian have the two room features, and is that rate flexible?

The quoted standard king lists a coffee maker and mini-fridge. The $594 rate is cancellable without penalty until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Sunday, July 5. After that deadline, the hotel charges one night, $198. Wednesday is available within the same reservation, so there is no room move.
The single hotel is simpler, but $89 more is meaningful. Check Eastgate carefully; its room price looked much lower.

Eastgate Suites is $169 per night including tax, or $507 for three nights, but the full amount is charged at booking and is nonrefundable. Estimated rides are $46 from the airport Monday, $64 round trip to the host meeting, $116 for four site legs Tuesday and Wednesday, and $46 to the airport Thursday. Transportation is $272, bringing the full cost to $779. It is the lowest room total but the highest complete total.
What about Wednesday availability and the room setup there?

Eastgate has continuous availability Monday through Thursday in the quoted room. The room description confirms a coffee maker but identifies only a shared refrigerator in the lobby, not one in the room. Because the rate is prepaid, there is no cancellation window after purchase. Its estimated Thursday drive to the terminal is 35 to 50 minutes in morning traffic.
Then I don’t see a reason to accept the prepayment and longer airport run. Put all three side by side once more, separating rooms from transportation.

Split stay: $606 lodging plus $76 transportation, $682 total; both rooms have a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and Wednesday airport access is strongest. Meridian: $594 lodging plus $177 transportation, $771 total; both features are in the room and there is no hotel change. Eastgate: $507 lodging plus $272 transportation, $779 total; no in-room refrigerator, fully nonrefundable, and the longest Thursday transfer. The split saves $89 versus Meridian and $97 versus Eastgate.

Choose the split. Reserve the host hotel for Monday and Tuesday and the Airport Courtyard for Wednesday. Make sure the host notes late bag pickup after the site shuttle, and use the flexible rates you quoted.

The split stay is selected for July 6 through July 9: two nights at the host hotel for $438 including tax and Wednesday at the Airport Courtyard for $168 including tax. Lodging is $606; estimated local transportation is $76; expected combined total is $682. Both rooms confirm a coffee maker and mini-fridge. The host reservation notes Wednesday bag storage and pickup after the returning site shuttle. Cancellation remains available until July 3 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern for the host hotel and July 7 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern for the Courtyard. The Wednesday airport stay avoids a Thursday cross-city transfer and preserves the flight margin. The Indianapolis rental car remains unnecessary under this arrangement, but the rides and host shuttle seats are estimates or requests rather than prepaid transportation confirmations.
